Resolve MIMAT accession IDs to canonical hsa-miR-* names

Source: R/mimat_hsa_lookup.R
resolve_mimat_to_hsa.Rd

Resolve MIMAT accession IDs to canonical hsa-miR-* names

Usage

resolve_mimat_to_hsa(ids)

Arguments

ids

Character vector of MIMAT accession identifiers, e.g. c("MIMAT0000062", "MIMAT0004481").

Value

Character vector (same length as ids) of canonical hsa-miR-* names. Entries not found in the lookup table are returned as NA_character_.

Details

Matching is case-insensitive on input; the returned value is always in canonical case (MIMAT IDs uppercase, e.g. MIMAT0000062; hsa-miR names lowercase, e.g. hsa-let-7a-5p). Unknown inputs return NA_character_.

Examples

resolve_mimat_to_hsa(c("MIMAT0000062", "MIMAT9999999"))
#> [1] "hsa-let-7a-5p" NA             
# [1] "hsa-let-7a-5p" NA
